D6 AMENDED (open-d71a52522428): a rehearsal step is named from the closed vocabulary the ticket itself provides — `D<n>` for the decision the step builds, or `unlisted: <text>` when the reader needs a step no decision covers. `unlisted` is a fifth gap kind: an unlisted step is itself a gap the ticket owes a decision for. validate() refuses a step outside the pattern and a `D<n>` the ticket's decisions[] does not carry (a re-read, like any schema lack); gaps() and the fold work on ids, so three readings converge by construction; the divergence resolves `D<n>` to the decision's text before tokenising. --decide takes the same vocabulary. Prompt: one node per decision a builder would carry out; a measurement or a ruling gets no node; never invent a D<n> the list does not carry.
